about: Navasota Mirror & Glass is at 27226 Hwy 6 S in Navasota and has served the area since 1982.

Owner Helen Ellis's shop handles residential and commercial glass, from shelves and desktops to storefront windows, plus auto, 18-wheeler and heavy equipment glass. It gives free estimates and is a U-Haul neighborhood dealer.
Customers have given it 4.3 stars across 63 Google reviews.
